module.purpose: Provides affine two-dimensional matrix modeling and transformation utilities for editor geometry, including composition, inversion, decomposition, point application, and CSS serialization.
module.summary: This module defines a mutable six-parameter affine matrix representation compatible with DOM-style transformation matrices. It supports instance mutation for chained transformations, static constructors and operations, decomposition into translation, scale, and rotation, conversion to vectors and CSS strings, and bounds translation. The implementation also accepts structural matrix models so callers can use either class instances or plain objects.
module.businessContext: Supports graphical editor geometry and rendering transformations. Failures can distort object placement, scaling, rotation, bounds, or serialized CSS transforms.

units.name: invert
units.source:
invert() {
		const { a, b, c, d, e, f } = this
		const denom = a * d - b * c
		this.a = d / denom
		this.b = b / -denom
		this.c = c / -denom
		this.d = a / denom
		this.e = (d * e - c * f) / -denom
		this.f = (b * e - a * f) / denom
		return this
